data.one_liner: Detects current network type and listens for connectivity changes on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a method to get the current network status, distinguishing Wi‑Fi, various mobile generations (2G‑5G) and other connections. Emits a stream that notifies listeners whenever the network state changes.
use_when: You need to know whether the user is on Wi‑Fi or a specific mobile generation
You want to react in real time to connectivity changes in a Flutter app
avoid_when: Your app must run on web, desktop, or platforms other than Android/iOS
You only need basic online/offline detection without detailed network types
strengths: Works on both Android and iOS
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS only
Does not provide HTTP/network request capabilities
data.setup_notes: Add READ_PHONE_STATE permission to AndroidManifest and request it at runtime on Android; no extra build steps required

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides basic online/offline and Wi‑Fi vs mobile status across more platforms, including web and desktop
